name: Coinzy
longDescription: Coinzy is our wedge into the world of coins, where we're going deeper to understand collectors, refine our model, and build the playbook for adjacent hobbies. Today, the platform brings these experiences together: identify coins from around the world with AI, explore and search a global coin catalog, discover their history, rarity, and value. Build your collection, connect with fellow collectors, buy and sell coins, and ask an experienced numismatist for a second opinion right in the app.
seoTitle: Coinzy AI: Coin Identifier, Collection and Marketplace
seoDescription: Scan a coin to learn its history, rarity, and estimated value. Keep your collection in one place, and buy and sell with other collectors and connect with real experts for appraisals. Free on iPhone and Android.
heroTitle: Everything for your coins, in one app.
heroDescription: Identify any coin and learn its history and value, get an expert's opinion, keep your collection organized, and buy and sell with collectors and dealers on the Coinzy marketplace.
featureCaptions: Take a photo and get the coin's name, country, year, and denomination.
Read the history behind each coin and the era it comes from.
See estimated value ranges by condition, from worn to uncirculated.
Browse more than 380,000 coins from around the world.
Track what you own, what you've identified and what you want.
List coins for free and contact sellers directly by phone or email.
Share finds and see what other collectors are posting.
Ask an experienced numismatist to review your coin and get a report within 72 hours.

name: Banknote
longDescription: Banknote is our wedge into the world of banknotes, where we're going deeper to understand collectors, refine our model, and build the playbook for adjacent hobbies. Today, the platform brings these experiences together: identify banknotes from around the world with AI, explore and search a global banknote catalog, discover their history, rarity, value, and security features. Build your collection, connect with fellow collectors, and buy and sell banknotes in the app.

name: Insecto
tagline: Discover insects and learn about them instantly
longDescription: Point your camera at any insect and Insecto will identify it instantly. Get detailed information about species, habitat, behavior, and whether they are beneficial or harmful.

name: Habiteazy
fullName: Habit Eazy - Habit & To Do Pal
tagline: Build positive habits and stay consistent
longDescription: Habiteazy makes habit building simple and rewarding. Track your streaks, set reminders, and visualize your progress with beautiful charts and motivational insights.

name: Rockzy
longDescription: Scan, collect, and explore over 8,000+ rocks and minerals with powerful AI tools. Identify rocks instantly, chat with AI, and build your collection.

name: Plantzy
fullName: Plantzy AI: Plant Care and ID
tagline: Scan, track, identify and care for all plants
longDescription: Plantzy uses advanced image recognition to identify plants and gives detailed suggestions on their care and growth. With a litany of smart tools integrated in the app, plant care has never been easier.

name: Antiqzy
tagline: Identify antiques, vintage items, and collectibles with AI
longDescription: Antiqzy helps you identify antiques, vintage items, and collectibles from photos. Get AI-generated insights like type, era, style, material, origin, condition indicators, and an estimated value range. Save items to collections, chat with AI, and optionally share or list items in the community/marketplace.
features: history rairty etc of your antiques
global catalogue with database of more than 100K antiques
which antique are you ! - fun element

name: Shroomzy
tagline: Identify mushrooms by photo with AI, maps, toxicity details and a fungi guide.
longDescription: Shroomzy: Mushroom Identifier is an AI-powered mushroom identification app for nature lovers, mushroom hunters, foragers, students and anyone who wants to learn about fungi. Take a photo or upload one from your gallery to identify mushrooms and explore likely matches in seconds. Explore a fungi guide with edibility and toxicity details, use the mushroom map for seasonal discovery, save finds to your collection, ask AI about fungi, and share discoveries with the community.
features: Safety Guide : Safe, edible or poisonous
